task.title: Withdrawal copy over-claims field freshness when the board read failed
task.description:
withdrawFailedIntentFromOpenDetail (internal/webui/assets/index.html) tells an open detail form "The fields you have not edited now show the version the server holds." When the withdrawal's forced refresh could not read the board, that is untrue — the fields show the last successful poll. Since PR #70, drainIntents holds a boardRead flag stating exactly whether the read landed, but does not pass it to the withdrawal, so the copy cannot distinguish the cases.

Disclosed in PR #70's review and confirmed unchanged in PR #73's. Display copy only — no wrong head is handed back — but it is the same message-honesty class those PRs fixed elsewhere.

Acceptance: boardRead is threaded into the withdrawal path; the sentence switches to honest wording when the read failed (mirroring the queue path's "could not be refreshed" phrasing PR #70 established); a harness test pins both variants.
